detail.longDescription:
The funny thing is, they're trying to make "AI" tools to do the cool jobs that humans want. 

Agent? Independent problem solver who can throw resources and creativity at a sticky wicket and bring back a solution? That sounds like the best jobs I've ever had in the army.

Why would I turn that into "press some buttons and a computer will do this badly with huge costs to society" and you're just, like, the agent's MANAGER?

#AgenticAI
